description:
Look up ocean container locations and shipping schedules directly in ChatGPT. Enter a container number to instantly get port of loading, port of discharge, estimated departure and arrival dates, and tradeflow references.

Useful for freight forwarders, logistics coordinators, and supply chain teams who need quick container status checks without switching to another app.
